agent_channels_external_check.name: agent_channels_external_check
agent_channels_external_check.value: "agent_channels"."type" not in ('slack', 'whatsapp') or "agent_channels"."status" = 'disconnected' or ("agent_channels"."external_account_id" is not null and "agent_channels"."connection_id" is not null)

agent_runs_finished_check.name: agent_runs_finished_check
agent_runs_finished_check.value: "agent_runs"."status" not in ('succeeded', 'failed', 'canceled', 'timed_out') or "agent_runs"."finished_at" is not null

agent_access_subject_check.name: agent_access_subject_check
agent_access_subject_check.value:
("agent_access"."subject_type" = 'organization' and "agent_access"."team_id" is null and "agent_access"."user_id" is null)
        or ("agent_access"."subject_type" = 'team' and "agent_access"."team_id" is not null and "agent_access"."user_id" is null)
        or ("agent_access"."subject_type" = 'user' and "agent_access"."user_id" is not null and "agent_access"."team_id" is null)

api_keys_state_check.name: api_keys_state_check
api_keys_state_check.value:
("api_keys"."status" = 'active') = ("api_keys"."key_hash" is not null)
        and ("api_keys"."status" = 'revoked') = ("api_keys"."revoked_at" is not null)

approval_assignees_subject_check.name: approval_assignees_subject_check
approval_assignees_subject_check.value:
("approval_assignees"."subject_type" = 'user' and "approval_assignees"."user_id" is not null and "approval_assignees"."team_id" is null and "approval_assignees"."role" is null)
        or ("approval_assignees"."subject_type" = 'team' and "approval_assignees"."team_id" is not null and "approval_assignees"."user_id" is null and "approval_assignees"."role" is null)
        or ("approval_assignees"."subject_type" = 'role' and "approval_assignees"."role" is not null and "approval_assignees"."user_id" is null and "approval_assignees"."team_id" is null)

approvals_decision_check.name: approvals_decision_check
approvals_decision_check.value: not ("approvals"."status" = 'rejected' and "approvals"."resolved_by" = 'user') or "approvals"."decision_reason" is not null

approvals_terminal_check.name: approvals_terminal_check
approvals_terminal_check.value:
("approvals"."status" = 'pending' and "approvals"."resolved_by" is null and "approvals"."decided_at" is null)
        or ("approvals"."status" <> 'pending' and "approvals"."resolved_by" is not null and "approvals"."decided_at" is not null)

approvals_timeout_check.name: approvals_timeout_check
approvals_timeout_check.value: "approvals"."expires_at" is null or "approvals"."timeout_action" is not null

users_disabled_check.name: users_disabled_check
users_disabled_check.value: "users"."disabled_reason" is null or "users"."disabled_at" is not null

chat_shares_subject_check.name: chat_shares_subject_check
chat_shares_subject_check.value: ("chat_shares"."subject_type" = 'user' and "chat_shares"."user_id" is not null and "chat_shares"."team_id" is null) or ("chat_shares"."subject_type" = 'team' and "chat_shares"."team_id" is not null and "chat_shares"."user_id" is null)

chats_deleted_check.name: chats_deleted_check
chats_deleted_check.value: "chats"."deleted_by_user_id" is null or "chats"."deleted_at" is not null

prompts_deleted_check.name: prompts_deleted_check
prompts_deleted_check.value: "prompts"."deleted_by_user_id" is null or "prompts"."deleted_at" is not null

connections_scope_check.name: connections_scope_check
connections_scope_check.value:
("connections"."scope" = 'organization' and "connections"."team_id" is null and "connections"."owner_user_id" is null)
        or ("connections"."scope" = 'team' and "connections"."team_id" is not null and "connections"."owner_user_id" is null)
        or ("connections"."scope" = 'personal' and "connections"."team_id" is null and "connections"."owner_user_id" is not null)

connections_revoked_check.name: connections_revoked_check
connections_revoked_check.value:
("connections"."status" = 'revoked') = ("connections"."revoked_at" is not null)
        and ("connections"."status" <> 'revoked' or "connections"."secret_ciphertext" is null)

guardrails_scope_check.name: guardrails_scope_check
guardrails_scope_check.value: ("guardrails"."scope" = 'organization' and "guardrails"."team_id" is null) or ("guardrails"."scope" = 'team' and "guardrails"."team_id" is not null)

pii_filter_rules_custom_check.name: pii_filter_rules_custom_check
pii_filter_rules_custom_check.value: ("pii_filter_rules"."pii_type" = 'custom') = ("pii_filter_rules"."custom_label" is not null and "pii_filter_rules"."custom_pattern" is not null)

pii_filter_rules_scope_check.name: pii_filter_rules_scope_check
pii_filter_rules_scope_check.value:
("pii_filter_rules"."scope" = 'organization' and "pii_filter_rules"."team_id" is null and "pii_filter_rules"."agent_id" is null)
        or ("pii_filter_rules"."scope" = 'team' and "pii_filter_rules"."team_id" is not null and "pii_filter_rules"."agent_id" is null)
        or ("pii_filter_rules"."scope" = 'agent' and "pii_filter_rules"."agent_id" is not null and "pii_filter_rules"."team_id" is null)

knowledge_base_access_subject_check.name: knowledge_base_access_subject_check
knowledge_base_access_subject_check.value:
("knowledge_base_access"."subject_type" = 'team' and "knowledge_base_access"."team_id" is not null and "knowledge_base_access"."user_id" is null)
        or ("knowledge_base_access"."subject_type" = 'user' and "knowledge_base_access"."user_id" is not null and "knowledge_base_access"."team_id" is null)

knowledge_sources_next_sync_at_idx.name: knowledge_sources_next_sync_at_idx
knowledge_sources_next_sync_at_idx.where: "knowledge_sources"."next_sync_at" is not null and "knowledge_sources"."deleted_at" is null

knowledge_sources_type_fields_check.name: knowledge_sources_type_fields_check
knowledge_sources_type_fields_check.value:
("knowledge_sources"."type" = 'file' and "knowledge_sources"."file_name" is not null and "knowledge_sources"."size_bytes" is not null
          and "knowledge_sources"."sha256" is not null and "knowledge_sources"."connection_id" is null)
        or ("knowledge_sources"."type" = 'connector' and "knowledge_sources"."connection_id" is not null)
        or ("knowledge_sources"."type" = 'link' and "knowledge_sources"."connection_id" is null)

organizations_member_read.name: organizations_member_read
organizations_member_read.using:
exists (
      select 1 from organization_members m
      where m.organization_id = "organizations"."id" and m.user_id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid and m.status = 'active')

organizations_deletion_check.name: organizations_deletion_check
organizations_deletion_check.value: "organizations"."status" <> 'deletion_scheduled' or ("organizations"."deletion_requested_at" is not null and "organizations"."deletion_scheduled_for" is not null)

budgets_scope_check.name: budgets_scope_check
budgets_scope_check.value:
("budgets"."scope" = 'organization' and "budgets"."team_id" is null and "budgets"."user_id" is null)
        or ("budgets"."scope" = 'team' and "budgets"."team_id" is not null and "budgets"."user_id" is null)
        or ("budgets"."scope" = 'user' and "budgets"."user_id" is not null and "budgets"."team_id" is null)

model_access_rules_subject_check.name: model_access_rules_subject_check
model_access_rules_subject_check.value:
("model_access_rules"."subject_type" = 'organization' and "model_access_rules"."team_id" is null and "model_access_rules"."user_id" is null)
        or ("model_access_rules"."subject_type" = 'team' and "model_access_rules"."team_id" is not null and "model_access_rules"."user_id" is null)
        or ("model_access_rules"."subject_type" = 'user' and "model_access_rules"."team_id" is null and "model_access_rules"."user_id" is not null)

vault_credentials_scope_check.name: vault_credentials_scope_check
vault_credentials_scope_check.value:
("vault_credentials"."scope" = 'organization' and "vault_credentials"."team_id" is null and "vault_credentials"."owner_user_id" is null)
        or ("vault_credentials"."scope" = 'team' and "vault_credentials"."team_id" is not null and "vault_credentials"."owner_user_id" is null)
        or ("vault_credentials"."scope" = 'personal' and "vault_credentials"."team_id" is null and "vault_credentials"."owner_user_id" is not null)

vault_credentials_revoked_check.name: vault_credentials_revoked_check
vault_credentials_revoked_check.value:
"vault_credentials"."status" <> 'revoked'
        or ("vault_credentials"."secret_ciphertext" is null and "vault_credentials"."revoked_at" is not null and not "vault_credentials"."is_primary")

vault_models_source_check.name: vault_models_source_check
vault_models_source_check.value:
("vault_models"."source" = 'local') = ("vault_models"."credential_id" is not null and "vault_models"."model_key" like 'local/%')
        and ("vault_models"."source" = 'trained') = ("vault_models"."trained_model_id" is not null and "vault_models"."model_key" like 'trained/%')
        and ("vault_models"."source" <> 'provider' or ("vault_models"."model_key" not like 'local/%'
          and "vault_models"."model_key" not like 'trained/%' and "vault_models"."model_key" not like 'platform/%'
          and "vault_models"."model_key" <> 'auto'))
